name: old-growth
description: Did the old champion league's Elo growth hold at ply 2 in a field of strong players? (11-11 ~00:40, after the user noted the old champions trained on ~10x more games yet trail the new flat LR although their league Elo kept growing.) Versions spanning each lineage's league growth (labels give the league's champion Elo), the top model of top-champions-1 as a fixed yardstick, all at ply 2, calibrated as their sources (depth-1 own games), 60 round-robins.
